faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about orders, delivery and products.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Go to the shop, add products to the cart, and click the Summary button.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: Yes, if the order has not been sent to fulfillment yet.

items.question: Which payment methods are available?
items.answer: In this project version, payments are treated as a later API integration step.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery usually takes from 1 to 3 business days.

items.question: Can I track my package?
items.answer: Eventually yes - order tracking will be available after backend implementation.

items.question: Do products have full descriptions?
items.answer: For now we use mock data. Full descriptions will come from the API.

items.question: Are the prices final?
items.answer: In the current version, prices are demo values used for interface testing.

items.question: Do I need an account to add products to the cart?
items.answer: No. The cart currently works locally and does not require login.
